players.bio: Afonso Bastardo Moreira (born 19 March 2005) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Lyon.

Aleix García Serrano (Catalan: ; Spanish: ; born 28 June 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Spain national team. He previously played for Girona from 2021 to 2024.

Arthur Augusto de Matos Soares (born 17 March 2003), simply known as Arthur, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a right back for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Brazil national team.

Christian Michel Kofane (born 26 July 2006) is a Cameroonian-French footballer who plays as a forward for German Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Club career Albacete Kofane joined Albacete Balompié's youth sides in November 2024, after the club established a partnership with AS Nylon.
Edmond Fayçal Tapsoba (born 2 February 1999) is a Burkinabé international footballer who plays for Bayer Leverkusen, as a centre back.

Eliesse Ben Seghir (born 16 February 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a left winger or left midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Born in France, he plays for the Morocco national team.
Exequiel Alejandro Palacios is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Premier League club Ipswich Town and the Argentina national team.

Ignacio Ezequiel Agustín Fernández Carballo (born 25 July 2002), better known as Equi Fernández, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.

Facundo Axel Medina (born 28 May 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Ligue 1 club Marseille, on loan from Lens, and the Argentina national team. Club career Medina's career got underway with a stint with River Plate, who he was an unused substitute for four times during the 2016–17 Argentine Primera División season.
Guéla Maho Lewis Doué (born 17 October 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.

Ibrahim Maza (Arabic: إبراهيم مازة; born 24 November 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Born in Germany, he plays for the Algeria national team.
Janis Jonathan Blaswich (born 2 May 1991) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.
Jarell Amorin Quansah is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.
Jonas Hofmann (born 14 July 1992) is a German footballer who plays as a right winger for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Germany national team.

Kasper Hjulmand (born 9 April 1972) is a Danish football manager and a former player, who is the head coach of Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. As a manager he led Nordsjælland to their first ever Danish Superliga title in 2012.
Loïc Séri Badé (born 11 April 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the France national team.

Lucas Vázquez Iglesias (born 1 July 1991) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or winger for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Starting his career at Real Madrid, Vázquez made his first-team debut in 2015 after a season on loan at Espanyol. He made his La Liga debut with the latter.

Malik Leon Tillman (born May 28, 2002) is a professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Born in Germany, he represents the United States national team. Tillman is a graduate of Bayern Munich's youth system, which he joined in 2015 from Greuther Fürth.
Mark Flekken (born 13 June 1993) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Netherlands national team.
Martin Albert Frédéric Terrier (born 4 March 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as winger or forward for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.
Miguel Gutiérrez Ortega (born 27 July 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who mainly plays as a left-back for La Liga club Girona.
Montrell Amare Culbreath (born 29 August 2007) is a German professional footballer who plays as a winger.
Moussa Diaby (born 7 July 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Ittihad and the France national team.
Nathan Adewale Temitayo Tella (born 5 July 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right winger for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.

Niklas Lomb (born 28 July 1993) is a German football goalkeeper who plays for 1. Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Career Lomb came through Bayer Leverkusen's youth setup and made his debut for the club in a UEFA Europa League tie against Rosenborg on 6 December 2012.

Patrik Schick (born 24 January 1996) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Czech Republic national team. Born in Prague, Schick began his career with local club Sparta Prague, rising through their youth ranks, before making his senior debut as a teenager.
Robert Andrich (born 22 September 1994) is a German footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.
Tim Oermann is a 22-year-old German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for the Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.

Victor Okoh Boniface (born 23 December 2000) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen, on loan from Bayer Leverkusen, and the Nigeria national team. Boniface signed for Glimt from Real Sapphire on 4 March 2019.
